translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Maenigaech we Aaen Rhooapwut we a Mae Pwiuniuwan
Jesus a fan fetaen nge a weriir rhooa naiwiis pwe ra iseis nong aar maenigaech noan nenien maenigaech me noan Temple we,
iwe nge a pwan weri erhai rhooapwut mwaenene a maenoa pwiuniuwan a iseis nong riiufai manfaifai pwe aan maenigaech.
Nge a iura pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe maenigaech na rhooapwut mwaenene we efang ina e temoag saengi aar oanongeer aeremas towunap kkewe.
Pwe oanongeer nge re iseni nong nusegin wiineer; nge rhooapwut een inamwo iga e igin affayeo nge efang oanongaen minikkena eno reen.”
Jesus e Aepesa Toaroponoan Temple we
Aaemweoi me neeiir rhooan kkayeo kkewe re fiffioangei Temple we reen nningen faai kkewe eno wooan me niffang kkewe aar aeremas ngaeni Deus. Nge Jesus a iura pwe,
“Oanongaen minikka oawwa weri, ina eyor eew oat ina epwe noa itto nge esooar efai faai kaan ne epwe notiw nenien; oanongan noa nge repwene toaropotiw.”
Affayeo me Aewwaeiraes
Ra aeiineow pwe, “Sinsei, ineeta epwe wen minneei? Meeta na epwe wen nge epwe pwaeri ngaenigemaem pwe minikkeei nge epwene wen?”
Jesus a iura pwe, “Oaw aefaennigaemi; oawteorh tupw. Towunepeer aeremas repwene itto faaen itaei nge repwene aepesa pwe, ‘Ngaang minne iiy! A ieei oatowe!’ Nge oawsoapw tapweer.
Oawsoapw mesag igine oawpwe rongorong kkepesaen moawun me fitigogon weni faniuw; ikkeei minikka epwe mmwaen wen, iwe nge saapw reen a arapeto ne soapwonoan.”
A pwan soapwei noa a pwan iura pwe, “Faniuw me faniuw nge repwene fiiow fengaen, eew mweoi me eew mweoi repwene moawun fengaen.
Epwene yor fanemwar tettemoag, me naengeta, me semwaai temoag me oanongaen pwiuneoi; epwene yor mini ariuriu me aemmesag ittiw me weei naaeng.

Ina rhag nge weni mmwaen minikkeei epwene wen, ina repwene torofigaemi nge ra aewwaeiraesigaemi; ra pwigigaemi noa noan wutteer Jews pwe oawpwene noa apwiung iwe nge oawnoa kanepwus; repwene pwigigaemi weni mmweer king me soamwoon pwe faaen itaei.
Nge a ieei oaton aaemi oawpwe aepesa Kkepas Mwamwaai we.
Oawpwe fasiun oamoannatae nee tipaemi pwe oawsoapw aiunaengiy aaemi noa saenetigaemi,
pwe ngaang ipwe ngaennegaemi mwaeniaemi me repiaemi nge esooar erhai rhooan kkoapwutomi epwe mmwen epwe appaniuwaeni aere paniuwaeni mwaeniaemi.
Aaemi ina inaemi me semaemi, pwiimi, perhaengiyaemi, me maereyaeremi, minne repwe fangenoa aaemi. Nge aaemweoi aaemi ina repwene nigaemi noa.
Oanongeer aeremas nge repwene oapwutaegaemi noa pwe faaen itaei.
Ina rhag ina eyaen mwo aennirhimwemi nge esoapw ppiung noa.
Oaw oarhorho, nge ina nge oawpwe menaw.
Jesus a Aepesa Wunuunun Ffeir Noan Jerusalem
“Igine oawpwe weriir sonotaw aar pwaeniaeniy noa Jerusalem, ina nge oawwa giuneei pwe a arap oaton aan epwene ffeir noa.
Iwe rhooawe reno Judea repwe fattapwetae weei rhug; rhooawe reno nee aepinoamw repwe siusaengi, rhooawe reno neman nge resoapw ittiw no nee aepinoamw.
Pwe ikkinaan raaenin kena raaenin aegaeregaer, nge minikkeei epwe pwaeritae minikkiwe mwaeniaen Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa.
Epwe ifa mwo aar affayeo rhooapwut pwoopwo me ikka re nayigit noan oaton naan! Temoagon aewwaeiraes epwene itto weni faniuw, nge aaen Deus aegaeregaer epwene itto wooar aeremas kaan.
Aaemweoi repwene mae wooan saeitan nge aaemweoi repwene pwigiir noa wooan aekkaaemweoi faniuw; nge re Gentiles ina repwene itto pwuraegraeg wooan Jerusalem toori aan moanno noa minna oatoor.
Itton Mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas
“Epwene yor eew aeginn epwene wen ngaeni aenet me meram me fiiu. Nge wooan soanop nge towunepaen faniuw repwene maegin no noan aewwaeiraes, repwene mesagiu piungpiungiun noa me pwuurtaen saaet.
Aeremas repwene niyoarorhrorh reen aar mesag noan aar wetiwet ngaeni meeta epwe wen ngaeni faeinaengiy, pwe minikkena maemaewaen noan naaeng repwene mwagiut saengi nenieer.
Noan oatonaan nge miniwe Naiun Aeremas epwene pwaeto me noan naengemaan reen maemaewan me nningen.
Oatona epwe wen minikkeei, nge oawwa iutae nge oawwa saeregi tae rhimwemi, pwe menewaemi ina a arapeto.”
Fenaiun Waniwan e Fig
Jesus a aengaeniir fioangon awewe een: “Oaw maengiy efoarh waniwan fig me oanongaen waniwan kkewe aaemweoi.
Nge oawpwe weri minikkena rheon pwe a pwiugiuw wow, oawwa giuneei pwe a arapeto neraeg.
Epwan ieei rhag taeppen, igine oawweri minikkeei pwe a wen, ina nge oawwa giuneei pwe arapeto minna Mweoiun Deus.
“Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe oanongaen minikkeei nge epwe wen weni mmwaen iga aeremesaen igina repwe maenoa.
Naaeng me soanop repwe soapwonoa, nge aaei kkepas esoapw soapwonoa.
Oaw Aefaennigaemi
“Oaw aefaennigaemi pwe oawte igin gupwun me oappwunaas me aaemi aiunaengiy menaen menaw eei, nge epwe tooto raaenin naan nge epwe rhiuwen torofigaemi rhag
taeppen iga oawyo noan taefirh. Pwe minneei ina epwe wen ngaeniir oanongeer aeremesaen noan faeinaengiy.
Ina oawpwe aefaennigaemi nge oaw maeipin noa rhag pwe epwe yor maemaewaemi noan oatonaan epwe wenewen minikkeei iwe me aaemi noa iutae me weni mmwaen mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas.”
Jesus aeni raaenin kkeei reen aan fenai noan Temple we, nge enoa nee oatofaaef, nge a noa wooan rhugun Olives.
Nee oatosor moawugowug nge oanongeer aeremas ra maegeto noan Temple we pwe repwe aiussaening ngaeni aan fenai.
